recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆邊界不規則的巨噬細胞，細胞質淡藍且多空泡，內含深藍色顆粒狀碎屑與大小不一的深染小圓體（凋亡核碎片），屬吞噬碎屑的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular, frayed borders
Cytoplasm containing coarse dark blue granular debris and numerous small dense round bodies of varying size (apoptotic nuclear fragments)
Macrophage nucleus partly obscured by overlying cells
No intact engulfed red cells or whole nucleated cells clearly identified
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils), erythroid precursors and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing coarse blue granular debris and numerous small dense round nuclear fragments of varying size. No intact phagocytosed cells are clearly identified. The background shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific marker of increased cell turnover or apoptosis (e.g. after chemotherapy, ineffective hematopoiesis or high-grade neoplasm).

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain intact red cells, platelets or whole nucleated cells, rather than fragmented nuclear debris.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules of ceroid pigment that stain with PAS and Sudan black, without apoptotic nuclear fragments.
Gaucher cells have a small eccentric nucleus and fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete debris or vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage in Burkitt or high-grade lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphologically the same cell; the context is defined by a background of sheets of lymphoma cells, which is not present in this field.
